decision_scope: CLASSIFY_ONLY_WHETHER_CURRENT_APPROVED_EVIDENCE_PROVIDES_A_BOUNDED_SOURCE_PACKAGE_FOR_POSITION_2; DO_NOT_ALLOCATE_POSITION_2, AUTHOR_NEW_HNK_CONTENT, REUSE_POSITION_1_PACKAGE, CREATE_CANONICAL_OPI_IDS_OR_LABELS, GENERALIZE_KE, UNLOCK_QA_OR_STR003_STR005, OR_ACTIVATE_RUNTIME

source_review_decisions.statement: Do not reuse VALI KE / PARAZAMI KE for position 2.
Do not derive a new position-2 question from available lexical items by analogy alone.
Keep position 2 unassigned and unauthored in this gate.
Create no canonical OPI ID or label and preserve selector 2 as NONCANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_INDEX_ONLY.
If approved, open only a separate position-2 source-gap strategy gate and stop.

governance_decisions.statement: Lexical evidence alone does not license a new interrogative construction or OPI source package.
No subject/person, tense/aspect, copula, habituality, future/planning, locative or purpose semantics are introduced or inferred.
No universal L03/HNK interrogative grammar or question-to-declarative derivation is created.
VALI FROZEN, PARAZAMI WATCH, KE CANDIDATE/non-generalized and other lexical authorities remain unchanged.
DARUNO/NELARA parent lexeme gate and HNK3000 remain untouched.
A future SIGA may approve only this position-2 source classification while this gate remains active.
